title: shaikidris/CollatzEndpointTransport-Palomar
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of a quantitative stability theorem for the one-block endpoint-pullback operator of the shortcut Collatz map. If an arbitrary target set has at most C N^(1-D) exceptions among the positive integers up to N, then, for every central Renyi order 1/2 < theta < 1, every admissible fixed central window, and every positive transport coefficient below the explicit asymptotic slope, its pullback through one floor(log_2 n)-step endpoint is (K(C+1)D^(-(1+theta)), transport*D)-dense whenever D is sufficiently small. The cutoff and K depend only on the fixed moment and transport parameters, not on the target set or C,D. This is an operator-level arbitrary-target theorem, not a pointwise convergence or eventual-descent claim.
